Give Daisy a happy expression as she roars. Any winter background is ok to use. Not required, but an additional version of the same drawing where Daisy is holding a Lagombi switch axe over her head would be appreciated. References for everything are included. Transparent versions are also appreciated. Thank you for you consideration
